note: schema_type! / schema! fixes: a bare source name inside an inline mod resolves to that module's struct, not a same-named derive of a sibling mod in the same file; serde_repr and Multipart derives behind cfg_attr are detected; a self_ref HasMany reads relation_reverse as its via_rel; garde rules naming a renamed sibling field follow the rename, and a sibling dropped by omit / pick / omit_default or wrapped alone by partial under matches(..) is a schema_type! diagnostic; bare Vec fields added to a multipart DTO get form_data(default); schema! rejects a path through another crate's import and a module without that derive instead of documenting another module's schema; try_from_multipart(strict) closes the schema; cfg-inactive twins no longer count as items for moved / stale detection; a source serde(remote) is not copied; omit_default also drops SeaORM default_expr columns.
